xmldoc.short_description: Find visible timer objects that match property criteria.

param_input_item.param_description: Timer object array used as the search source.
Property criteria. Returned timers must match all requested values.
Scalar structure whose fields contain property criteria.

param_output_item.param_description: Array of matching timer objects whose ObjectVisibility property is on.

description.p: timerfind returns visible timer objects that match all specified property criteria. Without criteria, it returns all visible timers.
Use timerfindall to include timers whose ObjectVisibility property is off.

example_item.example_item_description: Find a visible timer by tag.
Search within a supplied timer array.
